title: 第10章  第一次收获
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李阳打定主意，不叫秦淮茹把东西往家顺。

明儿个给她兜五斤棒子面，是宽她的心，免得她空着两手回去又挨骂。

贾家那几口人的德性他太清楚了，一旦叫他们沾上，往后就是没完没了的吸血虫。

往后秦淮茹来他这儿，管饱管够都行，就是不能兜着走。这规矩，头一回就得立下。

秦淮茹倒也没缠着要。说实话，她到现在也摸不准李阳到底是真穷还是装的。

要不是这趟回乡撞见他家的新房和新家具，她打死也想不到李阳有这底子。

毕竟在院儿里，李阳隔三差五就跟人张嘴借钱借粮，这事儿全院都知道。

日子长了，谁都觉得这人手里存不住钱，大手大脚，穷得叮当响。

李阳烧了满满一大锅热水，跟秦淮茹都洗利索了，又回里屋休息去了。

今儿个李阳就当是过大年了，可着劲地吃了一顿饱的。

秦淮茹就遭了罪了。熬到快半夜，才消停下来：

“不来了，说破大天也不来了，你太能祸害人了。”

李阳叫她唬了一跳。

他成年到头的往乡下跑，磕了碰了是常事，就央了个老郎中给配了一罐子药膏备着。这当口正好拿过来使。

秦淮茹抿着嘴偷笑，心里头暖乎乎的，觉得李阳这人是真心疼人。旁的先不说，她家里那个贾东旭，就从没这样待过她。

啥事都架不住比。一比，高下就出来了。

秦淮茹心里头想着，要不是自个儿拖着两个娃，就算眼下这婚没离，她也恨不能离了跟李阳过日子去。

李阳把药膏罐子收好，洗了把手，又钻进被窝：

“舒坦了吧？这药膏子金贵着呢，换旁人使，我还舍不得往外掏。”

秦淮茹轻轻拍了下他的手，咯咯笑起来：“别乱动弹，手冰死个人。”

又问：“赶紧瞅瞅几点了？怕是不早了，咱麻利睡，明儿个得早起。”

李阳从炕头矮柜上够过手表，凑着亮看了一看，说：“快十二点了，是该睡了，再熬明儿该起不来了。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Li Yang made up his mind not to ask Qin Huairu to deliver the things home.

I will give her five kilograms of stick noodles tomorrow to be merciful to her, lest she go back empty-handed and get scolded again.

He knew the virtues of the Jia family very well. Once they got involved, they would become endless blood-sucking insects.

From now on, when Qin Huairu comes to his place, he will be able to take care of him as much as he can, but he can't just walk around in circles.This rule must be established the first time.

Qin Huairu didn't bother asking for it.To be honest, she is still not sure whether Li Yang is really poor or just pretending.

If she hadn't come across his new house and new furniture on her return trip to her hometown, she would never have imagined that Li Yang had such a background.

After all, in the courtyard, Li Yang asked people to borrow money and food from time to time, and the whole hospital knew about this.

As time went by, everyone felt that this person could not save money, was lavish, and was extremely poor.

Li Yang heated up a large pot of hot water, and after both he and Qin Huairu were done, they went back to the back room to rest.

Li Yang regarded it as a New Year's Eve today, but he ate a full meal with all his heart.

Qin Huairu suffered a crime.I stayed up until almost midnight before I finally calmed down:

"You won't come, even Po Datian won't come. You are too capable of causing harm to people."

Li Yang shocked her.

At the end of his adult life, he ran to the countryside, and it was common for him to get bumped into, so he asked an old doctor to prepare a jar of ointment for him.This is the right time to bring it over.

Qin Huairu pursed her lips and snickered, feeling warm in her heart, feeling that Li Yang was really caring.Aside from other things, Jia Dongxu in her family has never treated her like this.

Nothing can be compared.After a comparison, the superiority will be revealed.

Qin Huairu thought in her heart that if she hadn't been dragging two children with her, even if the marriage was not divorced, she would have wanted to divorce and live with Li Yang.

Li Yang put away the ointment jar, washed the handle, and got into bed again:

"Are you feeling comfortable? This ointment is expensive. If it were someone else, I wouldn't be willing to take it out."

Qin Huairu patted his hand gently and chuckled: "Don't move around, your hands will freeze to death."

Then he asked: "Have a look at what time it is? I'm afraid it's getting late. Let's go to bed quickly and have to get up early tomorrow."

Li Yang reached for his watch from the low cabinet at the end of the kang, looked at it and said, "It's almost twelve o'clock. It's time to go to bed. I won't be able to get up until tomorrow."
